g + ao + first tone. ao sounds like the ow in "how".

m + an + fourth tone.

h + ong + second tone.

j + iao + fourth tone.

First tone + first tone: both high and level.
First tone + second tone: stay high, then rise.
First tone + fourth tone: stay high, then fall.
Fourth tone + first tone: fall, then jump back up high.
Second tone + first tone: rise, then stay high.
Second tone + third tone: rise, then go low.
Second tone + fourth tone: rise, then fall.
Third tone + first tone: stay low, then jump up high.
Third tone + second tone: stay low, then rise.
Third tone + fourth tone: stay low, then fall from high.
Fourth tone + second tone: fall, then rise.
Fourth tone + third tone: fall, then stay low.
Fourth tone + fourth tone: two falls, the second one stronger.
First tone + neutral tone: the second syllable is short and light.
Fourth tone + neutral tone: fall, then a light, short xie.
From 水 (water). As in 汤 (tāng, soup) and 河 (hé, river).
From 人 (person). As in 你 (nǐ, you) and 他 (tā, he).
At the bottom of a character. As in 想 (xiǎng, to think) and 您 (nín, you, polite).
心 standing on the left. As in 怕 (pà, to be afraid) and 忙 (máng, busy).
Short form of 言 (speech). As in 说 (shuō, to speak) and 谢 (xiè, to thank).
From 手 (hand). As in 打 (dǎ, to hit; to play) and 找 (zhǎo, to look for).
On top, from 草 (grass). As in 花 (huā, flower) and 茶 (chá, tea).
From 食 (food). As in 饭 (fàn, meal) and 饿 (è, hungry).
As in 地 (dì, ground) and 城 (chéng, city).
From 金 (gold). As in 钱 (qián, money) and 铁 (tiě, iron).

meaning: question word at the end of a sentence
note: 口 (mouth: a spoken word) gives the meaning; 马 (mǎ, horse) gives the sound.
亻 (person) gives the meaning; 门 (mén, door) gives the sound.
门 (door) + 日 (sun): sunlight through a gap in the door. Both parts give the meaning.
人 + 人: one person following another. Both parts give the meaning.

meaning: root, origin; measure word for books
note: 木 (tree) with a mark at its root. The tree gives the meaning.
木 (tree) gives the meaning; 子 (zǐ) sits below it. Think of a tree with its fruit.
木 (wood: cups were wooden) gives the meaning; 不 (bù) gives a rough sound.
火 (fire) gives the meaning; 丁 (dīng) gives the sound.
女 (woman) gives the meaning; 且 (qiě) gives the sound.
你 (you) + 心 (heart): you, said with respect. Both parts give the meaning.
心 (heart, mind) gives the meaning; 相 (xiāng) on top gives the sound.
讠 (speech) gives the meaning; 青 (qīng) gives the sound.
氵 (water) gives the meaning; 青 (qīng) gives the sound: clear water.
日 (sun) gives the meaning; 青 (qīng) gives the sound.
讠 (speech) gives the meaning. The right part looks like 舌 (shé, tongue): words come off the tongue.
艹 (plant) on top gives the meaning. Below are 人 (person) and 木 (tree): a person among plants and trees.
饣 (food) gives the meaning; 反 (fǎn) gives the sound.
